title: Kanbus Maximus trial orchestration
description:
Purpose: Build Kanbus-native orchestration for a no-merge Call Criteria trial run.

Definition of Done:
- Kanbus can claim ready work for a worker without double-dispatch.
- Kanbus can persist and inspect orchestration run records.
- Kanbus can load a workflow file, create an isolated target workspace, run a worker through Codex App Server, and push a trial branch only.
- Rust validation passes for the implemented scope.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Implementation started on branch feature/kanbus-maximus-trial. Scope: Rust-first Kanbus Maximus trial commands, durable run storage, workflow loading, and worker path for a safe Call Criteria trial. No PR or merge planned.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Kanbus Maximus trial branch implementation is complete for the Rust-first scope. Local Kanbus gates passed; Call Criteria end-to-end trial produced run records and exposed target environment failures before publish.
